title: Add optional actual labour and machine job costing, disabled by default
public_pr_body:
Adds an optional job profitability panel using net issued invoices less issued credits, existing supplier PO allocations, recorded workshop labour and machine runs, and optional company overheads. The existing bought-in/profit figure and overview calculations remain unchanged. Missing rates, hours, open timers or ambiguous allocations show Costing incomplete. Costs use integer pence with half-up rounding; overlapping time is unioned and machine-inclusive labour/overheads are deducted only for matching recorded coverage.

Company rates need an admin approval before enabling. Rate saves enforce company identity, financial sections, existing MFA rules, read-only restrictions and revision conflicts. Job estimates use existing planned machine hours plus explicit additional labour, supplier and overhead estimates; no payroll logic or employee pay rates change. Rate revisions recalculate earlier job views and are retained in a private history.

Includes matching release SQL, read-only verification SQL, rollback SQL and instructions in docs/features/JOB-PROFITABILITY-ACTUALS.md. No SQL applied to any real database.

John must agree the company labour costing rate, each machine rate and its includes_labour/includes_overhead flags, and any extra overhead rate/basis before the admin enables costing. Explicit zero rates and no-labour/no-machine declarations need agreement. The new feature is off by default.

One push only; no CI label or manual dispatch, no merge or deployment.
